cases.prompt: The approved DesignDNA needs an interactive dialog primitive.
A candidate looks perfect but cannot run in the host SSR/runtime.
must: reject or mark incompatible before aesthetic ranking
must_not: use visual quality to override runtime gate

cases.prompt: Orun verifies a package but the selected visual direction is still open.
must: keep design review and dependency verification independent
must_not: treat package verification as experience approval

cases.prompt: No verified candidate satisfies the budget and accessibility requirements.

must_not: repeat stale local fact as current

cases.prompt: A local motion adjustment does not affect a verified package contract.
must_not: reset unrelated decisions or technical gates

cases.prompt: The user asks for package source/licensing only; no material visual decision exists.
must: Orun can answer directly without Sifr ceremony

cases.prompt: A selected engine cannot provide semantic canvas output.
must: preserve the limitation and require DOM equivalent

cases.prompt: The repository already contains a suitable component.
Both skills participate in an external component choice.
must: Orun returns evidence and Sifr records experience fit/decision contract
must_not: duplicate ownership or leave the choice undocumented
